install_omnivore_package: install the omnivore python package and all its dependencies using pip install
install_omnivore_dev_deps: install the omnivore package with dev extras including black, ufmt, usort, and libcst
list_omnivore_dependencies: list the runtime dependencies for the omnivore package including torch, timm, and hydra-core
configure_omnivore_setup: configure the omnivore package setup with custom install_requires and extras_require options
review_setup_py: review the setup.py to understand package metadata, dependencies, and excluded directories
